title: Kissed Spicy Indian Rice Idli
description: A spicy and satvik-friendly Indian dish from Kerala, featuring candied peel and shio-koji-cure, with a unique glassy-jelly texture that is sure to please the crowd. This idli recipe is a perfect blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Soak the idli rice and urad dal in water for at least 4 hours.
Drain and grind the soaked rice and dal into a smooth batter using 2 cups of water.
Add the grated ginger, chopped green chili, salt, and shio-koji to the batter and mix well.
Stir in the chopped candied peel.
Heat the coconut oil in a small pan and add it to the batter.
Pour the batter into idli molds and steam for 15-20 minutes.
Remove the idlis from the molds and serve hot with your favorite chutney or sambar.
Garnish with additional chopped candied peel and grated ginger if desired.
